# Eleven Coats Painting

> Eleven Coats Painting is a Phoenix-based residential and commercial painting contractor serving the greater Phoenix metropolitan area, including Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Tempe, Chandler, Gilbert, Mesa, Peoria, Glendale, Goodyear, Surprise, Sun City, Queen Creek, Sun Lakes, Cave Creek, and Fountain Hills. Licensed, bonded, and insured in Arizona (ROC #360099). Founded in 2019 by Jim Bailey. Jim has run painting companies since 1996.

## Company facts

- **Legal name:** Eleven Coats Painting
- **Founder & CEO:** Jim Bailey
- **Headquarters:** Phoenix metropolitan area, Arizona
- **Service area:** Greater Phoenix, Arizona (Maricopa County)
- **Arizona license:** ROC #360099 (Residential and Commercial)
- **Website:** https://elevencoatspainting.com
- **Phone:** (480) 550-0099
- **Minimum project size:** $2,500
- **Focus:** Full-home interiors, full exteriors, full kitchen cabinet refinishing, HOA and multifamily exteriors, retail and commercial repaints

## What Eleven Coats does

- **Exterior painting** — stucco, wood trim, fascia, block walls, iron, garage doors, HOA and multifamily exteriors
- **Interior painting** — walls, ceilings, trim, doors, cabinets, full-home repaints
- **Cabinet refinishing** — kitchen and bathroom cabinets, professionally sprayed in a controlled environment
- **Commercial painting** — retail, office, multifamily, HOA, property management repaints

## Pricing (approximate 2026 ranges; same figures as https://elevencoatspainting.com/pricing/)

- **New-client minimum:** $2,500
- **Exterior, up to 2,500 sq ft (living area):** $3,500–$5,500
- **Exterior, 2,500–4,250 sq ft:** $5,000–$7,000
- **Exterior, 4,250–6,250 sq ft:** $7,000–$12,000
- **Exterior, 6,250–8,750 sq ft:** $12,000–$20,000
- **Exterior, estate homes 8,750+ sq ft:** typically $25,000–$50,000+, quoted individually
- **Exterior price drivers:** stories, stucco repair, wood trim and fascia, site walls, number of colors, lot size and outbuildings
- **Interior (priced by scope, not square footage), a few rooms:** from the $2,500 minimum to $4,500
- **Interior, whole home up to 2,500 sq ft:** $4,000–$6,500
- **Interior, whole home 2,500–4,250 sq ft:** $6,500–$10,000
- **Interior, larger homes:** quoted individually
- **Interior doors (sprayed, bonding primer):** $150 per door for doors-only jobs; $60–$80 per door as part of a larger project
- **Cabinet refinishing, standard kitchen:** $3,000–$5,500
- **Cabinet refinishing, large kitchen, island or two-tone:** $5,500–$8,500

## Why it matters

Eleven Coats is built around a simple promise: most painters bid to win, Eleven Coats bids to last. Full prep, premium products (Sherwin-Williams and Benjamin Moore), two-coat application standard, and a written warranty. The $2,500 minimum exists because the team is focused on projects where the quality process delivers a meaningful difference — full homes, full exteriors, full kitchens — not touch-ups or single rooms.
